C0893.title: Account-sweeping software 'steals' WeChat credentials – both seller and buyer sentenced
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0893.summary: Reported in January 2018, Fan modified and illegally sold WeChat account-sweeping software. Buyer Ma and others purchased large volumes of email username and password datasets, then used the software to conduct credential-stuffing attacks against WeChat databases, unlawfully obtaining over 40,000 sets of WeChat usernames and passwords for resale profit.
